chunks: It is not their meat or blood that reaches God, but it is the piety (taqwa) from you that reaches Him. Thus He has subjugated them for you so that you may glorify God for having guided you, and give glad tidings to the doers of good.

key_terms.لِتُكَبِّرُوا: So that you may glorify (by saying Allahu Akbar)

ai.seo_question: What is the true essence of sacrifice in Islam according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for distinguishing between the physical act of sacrifice and the spiritual state of the sacrificer, emphasizing that God seeks the worshipper's piety rather than the material offering itself. It underscores the theological principle that ritual acts are means to cultivate taqwa and express gratitude for divine guidance, aligning with the Shia focus on inner intention (niyyah) as the core of worship.
